title: Kissed Nutty Syrian Lentil Wrap
description: A nostalgic, nutty wrap packed with lentils, dried summer savory leaves, and toasted pine nuts, served wrapped in a fragrant lotus leaf.
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold water until the water runs clear.
Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a pot, add the lentils and dried summer savory leaves, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until the lentils are tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain the lentils and transfer them to a bowl, then stir in the diced onion, minced garlic, tomato paste, olive oil, salt, pepper, and lemon juice until well combined.
Allow the mixture to cool slightly, then fold in the chopped parsley.
Warm each lotus leaf over an open flame until pliable, then lay it flat on a clean surface.
Place a spoonful of the lentil mixture onto the center of each warmed leaf, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts, and roll the leaf tightly around the filling.
Place each wrapped lotus leaf into a steamer basket, cover, and steam for 5 minutes to heat through.
Serve the wraps warm with a side of lemon wedges for squeezing.
Enjoy the fragrant, nutty flavors of this nostalgic Syrian wrap.
